nodes.label: Template Classification Layout Engine
nodes.rationale: Predefined template classification guarantees visual alignment, robust typography, and premium aesthetics for direct-response marketing variants, trading arbitrary design flexibility for rendering reliability.

nodes.label: Dynamic JSON Layout
nodes.rationale: Rejected alternative to template classification: dynamically estimate arbitrary pixel coordinates for layout, offering maximum design flexibility but risking visual misalignment and typography degradation.

nodes.label: React-Konva Canvas Editor
nodes.rationale: Provides clean React-based state integration and seamless JSON serialization of visual layers (shapes, images, text blocks), making it easy to synchronize edits between the user, the backend Programmatic Assembler, and the AI agent. Superseded by ADR 0003.

nodes.label: HTML/CSS Satori Rendering
nodes.rationale: HTML/CSS layout templates rendered on the backend via Vercel Satori ensure near-perfect visual rendering parity between browser editor and backend assembler, ultra-fast serverless generation, and ease of deployment without native binary compilation.

nodes.label: AI Background Removal
nodes.rationale: Automated AI background removal using rembg or an API automatically isolates subjects (people/products) as transparent PNG assets, balancing ease-of-use with professional direct-response marketing design aesthetics.

nodes.label: AI Chat State Modification
nodes.rationale: Direct JSON layout state modification for the AI Live Chat Assistant: when a user requests a design change, the AI receives the current JSON layout state and outputs the fully updated JSON state, with frontend sanity validators preventing layout corruption and visual overflow.

nodes.label: Direct JSON Layout State Modification
nodes.rationale: Pattern where the AI chat assistant receives the current JSON layout state and outputs the fully updated JSON state atomically, chosen over structured tool-calling command execution for atomicity and simplicity.

nodes.label: Sanity Validators
nodes.rationale: Frontend validators that run position boundary checks and property range clamping on AI-returned layout JSON before applying it to React state, preventing layout corruption and visual overflow.

nodes.label: Deterministic JSON Assembly API
nodes.rationale: A deterministic JSON assembly endpoint guarantees 100% predictability, low latency, and clean error handling, allowing calling workflows (Make.com, Python scripts, orchestrator agents) to manage layout decision logic independently.

nodes.label: Next.js Framework
nodes.rationale: A unified Next.js TypeScript codebase where React components double as both browser editor layers and server-side Satori image rendering templates, simplifying routing, state sync, and deployment.

nodes.label: Unified Codebase
nodes.rationale: Design pattern where React components serve dual purpose as browser editor layers and server-side Satori image rendering templates, eliminating duplication between frontend and backend rendering logic.

nodes.label: Graphify Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-step pipeline: detect files, extract structurally (AST) and semantically (LLM), build graph, cluster communities, analyze god nodes and surprising connections, then generate outputs: HTML viz, GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.json.

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Core integrity constraints: never invent edges, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores behind symbols, never skip corpus check warnings, never run HTML viz on 5000+ node graphs without warning.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction (LLM)
nodes.rationale: Uses Gemini if GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is set, otherwise falls back to the host agent as the LLM. Never reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: Before traversal, expand the user's question against the graph's own token vocabulary to prevent wording mismatches from collapsing answers to noise. No stemming or synonym substitution — only tokens present in node labels.

nodes.label: Save Query Result (Feedback Loop)
nodes.rationale: Self-improving loop: saves Q&A pairs plus outcome tags (useful/dead_end/corrected) back into the graph as nodes, so future updates extract query history as preferred sources or known dead ends.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rules
nodes.rationale: IDs are lowercase [a-z0-9_], format: full repo-relative path with extension dropped, joined by underscores, then entity name normalized. Every directory level kept to prevent same-named files in different directories from colliding.

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete tiers rather than continuous range: EXTRACTED=1.0, INFERRED at 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55 (never 0.5), AMBIGUOUS=0.1-0.3. Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges.

nodes.label: Hyperedges (N-ary Relations)
nodes.rationale: When 3+ nodes participate in a shared concept not captured by pairwise edges, add a hyperedge. Maximum 3 per chunk. Examples: classes implementing a protocol, functions in an auth flow.
